translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer mourners were divided by a traveling curtain.

sentences.zh: 國官立哭於執紼者東，北面西上；

translations.literal: State officials wept east of cord holders, facing north ascending west;
translations.idiomatic: State officials wept east of the cord holders, facing north, west to east;

sentences.zh: 僚佐立哭於執紼者西南，北面東上。

translations.literal: aides southwest of cord holders, facing north ascending east.
translations.idiomatic: aides southwest of them, facing north, east to west.

sentences.zh: 祝帥執饌者設祖奠於輴東，如大斂。

translations.literal: Invoker led food bearers to set ancestor offering east of the bier, as at great shrouding.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker led food bearers to set the ancestor offering east of the bier, as at great shrouding.

sentences.zh: 祝酌奠，進饌，北面跪曰：「永遷之禮，靈辰不留，謹奉旋車，式遵祖道，尚饗。

translations.literal: Invoker poured and set offering, advanced food, faced north kneeling saying: "The rite of eternal removal—spirit day does not remain—we respectfully offer the turning carriage, following the ancestor's road—please partake.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker poured the offering and said kneeling north: "On this eternal journey the spirit tarries no more—we turn the carriage on the ancestors' road. Please partake."

translations.literal: " (close).
translations.idiomatic: End of the invocation.

sentences.zh: 輴出，升車，執披者執前後披，紼者引輴出，旌先，纛次，主人以下從哭於輴後。

translations.literal: Bier out, mounted on cart, pallbearers held front and rear pall, cord holders led bier out, banner first, great banner next, host and below followed weeping behind the bier.
translations.idiomatic: The bier went out and was mounted; pallbearers held the pall front and rear; cord men led it out, banner first, then great banner; the host and kin followed weeping behind.

sentences.zh: 輴出，到輀車，執紼者解屬於輀車，設帷障於輴後，遂升柩。

translations.literal: Bier out, reaching the hearse, cord holders tied cords to the hearse, set curtain screen behind the bier, then raised coffin.
translations.idiomatic: At the hearse, cords were tied on, a screen set behind the bier, and the coffin was raised aboard.

sentences.zh: 祝與執饌者設遣奠於柩東，如祖奠。

translations.literal: Invoker and food bearers set parting offering east of the coffin, as ancestor offering.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker set the parting offering east of the coffin as at the ancestor offering.

sentences.zh: 既奠，掌事者以蒲葦苞牲體下節五，以繩束之，盛以盤，載於輿前。

translations.literal: After offering, stewards wrapped the lower joints of the sacrificial animal in rush, bound with cord, placed in a tray, loaded before the cart.
translations.idiomatic: Stewards wrapped sacrificial joints in rush, bound them, placed them in a tray, and loaded them before the cart.

sentences.zh: 方相、大棺車、輴車，明器輿、下帳輿、米輿、酒脯醢輿、苞牲輿、食輿為六輿，銘旌、纛、鐸、輀車以次行。

translations.literal: Exorcist, great coffin cart, bier cart, spirit-object cart, lower canopy cart, grain cart, wine and dried-meat cart, wrapped-sacrifice cart, food cart—six carts; bright banner, great banner, bells, hearse in order.
translations.idiomatic: Six carts followed in order: exorcist, great coffin, bier, spirit goods, canopy, grain, wine and provisions, wrapped sacrifice, and food carts—then bright banner, great banner, bells, and hearse.

sentences.zh: 賓有贈者，既祖奠，賓立於大門外西廂，東面，從者以篚奉玄纁立於西南，以馬陳於賓東南，北首西上。

translations.literal: When guests had gifts, after ancestor offering guests stood in the west wing outside the great gate facing east; attendants with basket of black and red silk stood southwest, horses arrayed southeast of guest, head north ascending west.
translations.idiomatic: Gift-bearing guests stood in the west wing outside the gate facing east; attendants with black-and-red silk stood southwest; horses were arrayed southeast of the guest, heads north, west to east.

sentences.zh: 相者入，受命出，西面曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: The director entered, received command and came out facing west saying: "I dare request the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The director entered, received orders, and came out facing west: "I dare request instructions."

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢賵。

translations.literal: " Guest said: "I dare present funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "I present funeral gifts."

sentences.zh: 」相者入告，出曰：「孤某須矣。

translations.literal: " Director entered to report, came out saying: "The orphan awaits.
translations.idiomatic: The director reported within and returned: "The orphan awaits."

sentences.zh: 」執篚者奠，取幣以授賓。

translations.literal: Basket holder set offering, took silk to hand to guest.
translations.idiomatic: The basket holder set the gift and handed the silk to the guest.

sentences.zh: 牽馬者先入，陳於輴車南，北首西上。

translations.literal: Horse leaders entered first, arrayed south of the bier cart, head north ascending west.
translations.idiomatic: Horse leaders entered first and arrayed the horses south of the bier cart, heads north, west to east.

sentences.zh: 賓入，由馬西當輴車南，北面立，內外止哭。

translations.literal: Guest entered, west of the horses opposite south of the bier cart, stood facing north; inner and outer stopped weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The guest entered west of the horses, south of the bier cart, faced north; weeping ceased.

sentences.zh: 賓曰：「某謚封若某位，將歸幽宅，敢致賵。

translations.literal: Guest said: "I, posthumous title and enfeoffment or such-and-such rank, return to the dark dwelling—I dare present gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "I, bearing such posthumous title and rank, return to the tomb—I present these gifts."

sentences.zh: 」乃哭，內外皆哭。

translations.literal: " Then wept; inner and outer all wept.
translations.idiomatic: Then he wept; all wept.

sentences.zh: 主人拜稽顙。

translations.literal: Host bowed prostrate.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed to the ground.

sentences.zh: 賓進輴東，西面，奠幣於車上，西出，主人拜稽顙送之。

translations.literal: Guest advanced east of the bier facing west, set silk on the cart, exited west; host bowed prostrate in send-off.
translations.idiomatic: The guest advanced west of the bier, set the silk on the cart, left westward; the host bowed to the ground in farewell.

sentences.zh: 喪至于墓所，下柩。

translations.literal: When the mourning reached the tomb site, lowered the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: At the tomb the coffin was lowered.

sentences.zh: 進輴車於柩車之後，張帷，下柩於輴。

translations.literal: Advance bier cart behind the coffin cart, hang curtains, lower coffin onto the bier.
translations.idiomatic: The bier cart moved behind the coffin cart; curtains were hung; the coffin was lowered onto the bier.

sentences.zh: 丈夫在西，憑以哭。

translations.literal: Men west, leaning weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Men stood west, leaning on the bier and weeping.

sentences.zh: 卑者拜辭，主人以下婦人皆障以行帷，哭於羨道西，東面北上。

translations.literal: Juniors bowed in leave-taking; host and below, women all screened by traveling curtain, wept west of the passage facing east ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Juniors bowed farewell; the host and women, screened by curtains, wept west of the passage facing east, north to south.

sentences.zh: 入墓。

translations.literal: Enter the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Enter the tomb chamber.

sentences.zh: 施行席於壙戶內之西，執紼者屬紼於輴，遂下柩於壙戶內席上，北首，覆以夷衾。

translations.literal: Spread mats west within the tomb door, cord holders tied cords to the bier, then lowered coffin on the mat within the tomb door facing north, covered with plain quilt.
translations.idiomatic: Mats were spread west inside the tomb door; cords lowered the north-facing coffin onto them and it was covered with a plain quilt.

sentences.zh: 輴出，持翣入，倚翣於壙內兩廂，遂以帳張於柩東，南向。

translations.literal: Bier out, fan holders entered, leaned fans on both sides within the tomb, then hung canopy east of the coffin facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The bier withdrew; fan bearers set fans on both sides inside, then hung a south-facing canopy east of the coffin.

sentences.zh: 米、酒、脯於東北，食盤設於前，醯、醢設於盤南，苞牲置於四隅，明器設於右。

translations.literal: Grain and wine northeast, food tray before, vinegar and relish south of the tray, wrapped sacrifice at the four corners, spirit objects on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and wine were set northeast; a food tray before; vinegar and relish south of it; wrapped sacrifice at the corners; spirit objects on the right.

sentences.zh: 在壙。

translations.literal: In the tomb chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the tomb chamber.

sentences.zh: 掌事者以玄纁授主人，主人授祝，奉以入，奠於靈座，主人拜稽顙。

translations.literal: Stewards handed black and red silk to the host; host handed to invoker, who bore it in, set at the spirit seat; host bowed prostrate.
translations.idiomatic: Stewards gave black-and-red silk to the host, who gave it to the invoker to place at the spirit seat; the host bowed to the ground.

sentences.zh: 施銘旌、誌石於壙門之內，掩戶，設關鑰，遂復土三。

translations.literal: Set bright banner and epitaph stone inside the tomb door, close the door, set lock and key, then fill earth three times.
translations.idiomatic: The bright banner and epitaph were set inside the tomb door; the door was closed, locked, and earth filled in three layers.

sentences.zh: 主人以下稽顙哭，退，俱就靈所哭。

translations.literal: Host and below bowed prostrate weeping, withdrew, all went to the spirit place weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The host and kin bowed to the ground, withdrew, and wept at the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 掌儀者祭后土於墓左。

translations.literal: Director of rites offered to the earth god left of the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The rites director offered to the earth god left of the tomb.

sentences.zh: 反哭。

translations.literal: Return weeping.
translations.idiomatic: They returned home weeping.

sentences.zh: 既下柩於壙，搥一鼓為一嚴，掩戶；

translations.literal: After lowering the coffin in the tomb chamber, one drum-strike for first vigil, close the door;
translations.idiomatic: After the coffin was lowered, the first vigil drum sounded and the tomb door was closed;

sentences.zh: 搥二鼓為再嚴，內外就靈所；

translations.literal: two drums for second vigil, inner and outer at the spirit place;
translations.idiomatic: at the second vigil drum, mourners gathered at the spirit seat;

sentences.zh: 搥三鼓為三嚴，徹酒、脯之奠，追靈車於帷外，陳布儀仗如來儀。

translations.literal: three drums for third vigil, remove wine and dried-meat offering, pursue spirit cart outside the curtain, array guards as on coming.
translations.idiomatic: at the third, wine and dried-meat offerings were removed and the spirit cart was escorted outside the curtain with guards arrayed as on arrival.

sentences.zh: 腰輿入，少頃出，詣靈車後。

translations.literal: Litter entered, shortly came out, went to behind the spirit cart.
translations.idiomatic: The litter entered briefly, then went behind the spirit cart.

sentences.zh: 靈車發引，內外從哭如來儀。

translations.literal: Spirit cart set out, inner and outer followed weeping as on coming.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit cart set out; mourners followed weeping as on arrival.

sentences.zh: 出墓門，尊者乘，去墓百步，卑者乘以哭。

translations.literal: Outside the tomb gate, elders rode; one hundred paces from the tomb, juniors rode weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the tomb gate elders rode; a hundred paces on, juniors rode while weeping.

sentences.zh: 靈車至第西階下，南向。

translations.literal: Spirit cart to below the west steps of the residence, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit cart stopped below the residence's west steps, facing south.

sentences.zh: 祝以腰輿詣靈車後。

translations.literal: Invoker with litter went to behind the spirit cart.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker with the litter went behind the spirit cart.

sentences.zh: 少頃，升，入詣靈座前；

translations.literal: Shortly, ascended, entered before the spirit seat;
translations.idiomatic: Soon he ascended and entered before the spirit seat;

sentences.zh: 主人以下從升，立於靈座東，西面南上；

translations.literal: host and below followed ascending, stood east of the spirit seat, facing west ascending south;
translations.idiomatic: the host and kin followed, standing east of the seat facing west, ranked south to north;

sentences.zh: 內外俱升。

translations.literal: inner and outer all ascended.
translations.idiomatic: all mourners inside and out ascended.

sentences.zh: 諸祖父以下哭於帷東北壁下，南面；

translations.literal: Grandfathers and below wept northeast of the curtain facing south;
translations.idiomatic: Grandfathers wept northeast of the curtain facing south;

sentences.zh: 妻及女子子以下婦人哭於靈西，東面；

translations.literal: wife and daughters and women wept west of the spirit facing east;
translations.idiomatic: wife, daughters, and women wept west of the spirit seat facing east;

sentences.zh: 諸祖母以下哭於帷西北壁下，南面；

translations.literal: grandmothers and below northwest of the curtain facing south;
translations.idiomatic: grandmothers northwest of the curtain facing south;

sentences.zh: 外姻哭於南廂，丈夫帷東，婦人帷西，皆北面；

translations.literal: outer affines wept in the south wing, men east of curtain, women west, all facing north;
translations.idiomatic: outer affines wept in the south wing—men east of the curtain, women west—all facing north;

sentences.zh: 弔者哭於堂上，西面。

translations.literal: condolence visitors wept in the hall facing west.
translations.idiomatic: Condolence visitors wept in the hall, facing west.

sentences.zh: 主人以下出就次，沐浴以俟虞，斬衰者沐而不櫛。

translations.literal: Host and below went out to the hut, bathed to await yu; severest hemp bathed but did not comb.
translations.idiomatic: The host withdrew to the hut to bathe before the yu rite; those in severest hemp bathed but did not comb.

sentences.zh: 虞。

translations.literal: Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The yu offering.

sentences.zh: 主用桑，長尺，方四寸，孔徑九分，烏漆匱，置於靈座，在寢室內戶西，東向，素几在右。

translations.literal: Host used mulberry, one foot long, four inches square, hole diameter nine fen, black-lacquered case, set at spirit seat west within the chamber door facing east, plain table right.
translations.idiomatic: The host's tablet was mulberry wood one foot by four inches, hole nine fen, in a black-lacquered case west inside the chamber door facing east, with a plain table to the right.

sentences.zh: 設洗於西階西南，瓦甒二、設於北牖下，醴、酒在東。

translations.literal: Set washstand southwest of west steps, two pottery jars below north window, ale and wine east.
translations.idiomatic: A washstand stood southwest of the west steps; two jars below the north window, ale and wine to the east.

sentences.zh: 喪者既沐，升靈所。

translations.literal: After mourners bathed, ascended to the spirit place.
translations.idiomatic: After bathing, mourners went up to the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 主人及諸子倚杖於戶外，入哭于位如初。

translations.literal: Host and sons leaned on staffs outside the door, entered weeping at position as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The host and sons leaned on staffs outside the door, then entered and wept at their stations.

sentences.zh: 饌入，如殷奠，升自東階。

translations.literal: Food entered as generous offering, ascended east steps.
translations.idiomatic: Food was brought in as at a generous offering, up the east steps.

sentences.zh: 主人盥手洗爵，酌醴，西面跪奠，哭止。

translations.literal: Host washed hands, washed goblet, poured ale, faced west kneeling and set offering, weeping stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The host washed, filled a goblet with ale, knelt facing west, set the offering, and weeping ceased.

sentences.zh: 祝跪讀祝，主人哭拜，內外應拜者皆哭拜。

translations.literal: Invoker knelt reading prayer, host wept and bowed, inner and outer responders all wept and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker knelt and read the prayer; the host wept and bowed; all mourners who should respond did likewise.

sentences.zh: 乃出，杖降西階，還次。

translations.literal: Then went out, staff descended west steps, returned to hut.
translations.idiomatic: He then withdrew, descended the west steps with his staff, and returned to the hut.

sentences.zh: 間日再虞，後日三虞，禮如初。

translations.literal: After an interval, second yu; after another day, third yu—rite as at first.
translations.idiomatic: After an interval came the second yu; the next day the third—each like the first.

sentences.zh: 小祥。

translations.literal: Lesser felicity.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser felicity rites.

sentences.zh: 毀廬為堊室，設蒲席。

translations.literal: Destroy hut into whitewashed chamber, set rush mat.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning hut became a whitewashed chamber with a rush mat.

sentences.zh: 堊室者除之，席地。

translations.literal: Whitewashed chamber removed, sit on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The whitewashed chamber was removed; mourners sat on the ground.

sentences.zh: 主人及諸子沐浴櫛翦，去首絰，練冠，妻妾女子去腰絰。

translations.literal: Host and sons bathed, combed, trimmed, removed headband, wore dyed-cap mourning; wife, concubines, and women removed waist bands.
translations.idiomatic: Host and sons bathed, groomed, removed headbands, and wore dyed-cap mourning; wives and women removed waist bands.

sentences.zh: 主用栗，祭如虞禮。

translations.literal: Host used chestnut wood; offering as yu rite.
translations.idiomatic: The host's tablet was chestnut wood; offerings followed the yu rite.

sentences.zh: 大祥之祭如小祥。

translations.literal: Greater felicity offering as lesser felicity.
translations.idiomatic: Greater felicity offerings matched lesser felicity.

sentences.zh: 間月而禫，釋祥服，而禫祭如大祥。

translations.literal: After an interval, unhemmed; remove felicity dress, unhemmed offering as greater felicity.
translations.idiomatic: After an interval came unhemmed mourning; felicity dress was removed and the unhemmed offering matched greater felicity.

sentences.zh: 既祥而還外寢。

translations.literal: After felicity, return to the outer chamber.
translations.idiomatic: After felicity, mourners returned to the outer chamber.

sentences.zh: 妻妾女子還於寢。

translations.literal: Wife, concubines, and women returned to the inner chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Wives, concubines, and women returned to the inner quarters.

sentences.zh: 食有醢、醬，既禫而飲醴酒，食乾肉。

translations.literal: Food had relish and sauce; after unhemmed, drink ale and eat dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: Food included relish and sauce; after unhemmed mourning they drank ale and ate dried meat.

sentences.zh: 祔廟，筮日。

translations.literal: Affination in the temple; divine the day.
translations.idiomatic: Affination in the ancestral temple; the day was divined.

sentences.zh: 將祔，掌事者為埳室於始祖廟室西壁，主人及亞獻以下散齊三日，致齊一日。

translations.literal: When about to affinate, stewards made a niche chamber west wall of the founder's temple; host and secondary and final offerers scattered fast three days, concentrated fast one day.
translations.idiomatic: Before affination, stewards prepared a niche west of the founder's temple; host, secondary, and final offerers kept scattered fast three days and full fast one.

sentences.zh: 前一日，主人以酒、脯告遞遷之主，乃遷置於幄坐，又奠酒、脯以安神。

translations.literal: Day before, host with wine and dried meat reported to the spirits being moved; then moved them to curtain seats, again set wine and dried meat to settle the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, the host reported with wine and dried meat to the spirits being moved, placed them on curtained seats, and offered wine and dried meat to settle them.

sentences.zh: 掌饌者徹膳以出，掌廟者以次匵神主納於埳室。

translations.literal: Food stewards removed meals and went out; temple stewards in order placed spirit tablets in cases into the niche chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Food stewards withdrew; temple stewards placed cased tablets into the niche in order.

sentences.zh: 又設考之祔坐於曾祖室內東壁下，西向，右几。

translations.literal: Again set the father's affination seat east wall within the great-grandfather's chamber facing west, table right.
translations.idiomatic: The father's affination seat was set on the east wall of the great-grandfather's chamber, facing west, table to the right.

sentences.zh: 設主人位於東南，西面。

translations.literal: Set host's position southeast, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host's place was southeast, facing west.

sentences.zh: 設子孫位於南門內道東，北面西上。

translations.literal: Set descendants' position east of the south gate within the path, facing north ascending west.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants stood east inside the south gate on the path, facing north, ranked west to east.

sentences.zh: 設亞獻、終獻位於主人東南。

translations.literal: Set secondary and final offerers' positions southeast of the host.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerers stood southeast of the host.

sentences.zh: 設掌事以下位於終獻東南，俱西面北上。

translations.literal: Set stewards and below southeast of the final offerer, all facing west ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Stewards and below stood southeast of the final offerer, facing west, ranked north to south.

sentences.zh: 設贊唱者位於主人西南，西面。

translations.literal: Set announcer's position southwest of the host, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer stood southwest of the host, facing west.

sentences.zh: 設酒尊於堂上室戶之東南，北向西上。

translations.literal: Set wine jars southeast of the chamber door in the hall, facing west ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Wine jars stood southeast of the hall door, facing west, ranked north to south.

sentences.zh: 設洗於阼階東南，北向，實爵三，巾二，加冪。

translations.literal: Set washstand southeast of the east steps facing north, three goblets filled, two kerchiefs, with covers.
translations.idiomatic: A washstand stood southeast of the east steps facing north, with three filled goblets, two kerchiefs, and covers.

sentences.zh: 其日，具少牢之饌二座，各俎三、簋二、簠二、鈃二。

translations.literal: On that day, prepare two sets of young livestock food, each three trays, two grain baskets, two square baskets, two bells.
translations.idiomatic: That day, two sets of young livestock offerings were prepared, each with three trays, two grain baskets, two square baskets, and two bells.

sentences.zh: 酒尊二，其一實玄酒為上，其一實清酒次之。

translations.literal: Two wine jars, one filled with dark water as superior, one with clear wine next.
translations.idiomatic: Two wine jars: one with dark water as primary, one with clear wine as secondary.

sentences.zh: 其籩豆，一品者各十二，二品、三品者各八。

translations.literal: For baskets and dishes: first rank twelve each; second and third rank eight each.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and dishes: twelve each for first rank; eight for second and third.

sentences.zh: 主人及行事者祭服。

translations.literal: Host and performers in sacrificial dress.
translations.idiomatic: Host and ritual officers wore sacrificial dress.

sentences.zh: 掌事者具腰輿，掌廟者、閽寺人立於廟庭，北面再拜，升自東階，入，開埳室，出曾祖、曾祖妣神主置於座，降，出。

translations.literal: Stewards prepared litter; temple stewards and gatekeepers stood in temple courtyard facing north bowing twice, ascended east steps, entered, opened niche, took out great-grandfather and great-grandmother tablets to seats, descended and went out.
translations.idiomatic: Stewards prepared litters; temple officers stood in the courtyard, bowed twice facing north, entered by the east steps, opened the niche, brought out the great-grandparents' tablets, then left.

sentences.zh: 執尊、罍、篚者入就位，祝進座前，西面告曰：「以今吉辰，奉遷神主于廟。

translations.literal: Jar and basket holders entered position; invoker advanced before the seat facing west announcing: "On this auspicious day we respectfully move the spirit tablets to the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Jar and basket holders took position; the invoker announced west before the seat: "On this auspicious day we move the spirit tablets to the temple."

sentences.zh: 」執輿者以輿升，入，進輿於座前，祝納神主於匵，升輿，祝仍扶於左，降自西階，子孫內外陪從於後。

translations.literal: Litter bearers raised litter, entered, advanced litter before the seat; invoker placed tablet in case, raised litter, invoker still supported on the left, descended west steps, sons and grandsons inside and outside followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: Bearers brought the litter in; the invoker cased the tablet, lifted the litter, supported it on the left, descended the west steps, and kin followed.

sentences.zh: 至廟門，諸婦人停於門外，周以行帷，俟祭訖而還。

translations.literal: At temple gate, all women stopped outside, surrounded by traveling curtain, awaited until the rite ended and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the temple gate all women waited outside within a traveling curtain until the rite ended.

sentences.zh: 神主入自南門，升自西階，入於室。

translations.literal: Spirit tablet entered from south gate, ascended west steps, entered the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The tablet entered by the south gate, ascended the west steps, and entered the chamber.

sentences.zh: 諸子孫從升，立於室戶西，重行東面，以北為上。

translations.literal: Sons and grandsons followed ascending, stood west of the chamber door, double ranks facing east, north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and grandsons followed up and stood west of the door in double file facing east, north to south by seniority.

sentences.zh: 行事者從入，各就位。

translations.literal: Performers followed in, each took position.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers entered and took their stations.

sentences.zh: 輿詣室前，迴輿西向。

translations.literal: Litter came before the chamber, turned litter facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The litter came before the chamber and was turned west.

sentences.zh: 祝啟匵出神主，置於坐。

translations.literal: Invoker opened case and took out spirit tablet, set on seat.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker opened the case, removed the tablet, and set it on the seat.

sentences.zh: 輿降立於西階下，東向。

translations.literal: Litter descended standing below west steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The litter was set down below the west steps facing east.

sentences.zh: 相者引主人以下降自東階，各就位。

translations.literal: Director led host and below down east steps, each took position.
translations.idiomatic: The director led the host and others down the east steps to their stations.

sentences.zh: 祝立定，贊唱者曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: Invoker stood settled; announcer said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: When the invoker was in place, the announcer said: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " All in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 掌饌者引饌入，升自東階，入於室，各設於神座前。

translations.literal: Food steward led food in, ascended east steps, entered chamber, each set before spirit seats.
translations.idiomatic: Food stewards brought offerings up the east steps and set them before each spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 主人盥手，洗爵，升自東階，酌醴酒，入室，進，北面跪，奠爵於曾祖神座前。

translations.literal: Host washed hands, washed goblet, ascended east steps, poured ale, entered chamber, advanced, faced north kneeling, set goblet before great-grandfather's seat.
translations.idiomatic: The host washed, filled a goblet, entered, knelt north before the great-grandfather's seat, and set the goblet down.

sentences.zh: 主人出，取爵酌酒，入室，進，東面跪，奠於祖座前。

translations.literal: Host out, took goblet poured wine, entered chamber, advanced, faced east kneeling, set before grandfather's seat.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew, refilled the goblet, entered again, knelt east before the grandfather's seat, and set it down.

sentences.zh: 出戶，北面立。

translations.literal: Out of door, stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: He left the chamber and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 祝持版進於室戶外之右，東向跪讀祝文，主人再拜。

translations.literal: Invoker held plaque advanced right outside chamber door facing east kneeling reading prayer text, host bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker knelt east outside the door, read the prayer on a plaque, and the host bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 祝進，入奠版於曾祖座。

translations.literal: Invoker advanced, entered set plaque at great-grandfather's seat.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker entered and placed the plaque at the great-grandfather's seat.

sentences.zh: 主人出，降，還本位。

translations.literal: Host out, descended, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The host withdrew, descended, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 初，主人出，亞獻盥手，洗爵，升，酌酒入，進，北面跪，奠於曾祖，又酌酒入，進，東面跪，奠於祖神座，出戶，北面再拜訖，又入室，立於西壁下，東面再拜，出，降，復位。

translations.literal: At first when host went out, secondary offerer washed hands, washed goblet, ascended, poured entered, advanced north kneeling set at great-grandfather, again poured entered advanced east kneeling set at grandfather's seat, out of door faced north bowed twice finished, again entered chamber stood west wall below facing east bowed twice, out descended returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: When the host withdrew, the secondary offerer washed, filled a goblet, offered north to the great-grandfather and east to the grandfather, bowed twice outside the door, re-entered, bowed twice east at the west wall, then withdrew to station.

sentences.zh: 亞獻將畢，終獻入如亞獻。

translations.literal: When secondary offerer nearly finished, final offerer entered as secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: As the secondary offerer finished, the final offerer performed the same rite.

sentences.zh: 祝入，徹豆，贊者皆再拜。

translations.literal: Invoker entered, removed beans, announcers all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker cleared the beans; announcers all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 主人及在位子孫以下出。

translations.literal: Host and present sons and grandsons and below went out.
translations.idiomatic: The host and all present descendants withdrew.

sentences.zh: 掌饌者入，徹饌以出。

translations.literal: Food steward entered, removed food and went out.
translations.idiomatic: Food stewards removed the offerings and left.

sentences.zh: 掌廟者納曾祖神主於埳室，出，又以腰輿升諸考神座前，納主於匵，置於輿，詣考廟，出神主置於座，進酒、脯之奠，少頃，徹之。

translations.literal: Temple steward placed great-grandfather tablet in niche, out, again with litter ascended before father's seats, placed tablet in case on litter, went to father's temple, took out tablet set on seat, advanced wine and dried-meat offering, shortly removed.
translations.idiomatic: Temple stewards returned the great-grandparents' tablets to the niche, then carried the father's tablet in its case to his temple, set it out, offered wine and dried meat briefly, and removed them.

sentences.zh: 祝納神主於埳室。

translations.literal: Invoker placed spirit tablet in niche chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker returned the spirit tablet to the niche.

sentences.zh: 六品以下祔祭于正寢，禮略如之。

translations.literal: Sixth rank and below affinated in the main chamber; rite broadly the same.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of sixth rank and below affinated in the main chamber; the rite was substantially the same.
